cells.label: Charged restraint and chosen stopping
cells.opening_fragment: Jonah stopped beneath the unlit arch and waited for Mara to decide what his silence meant.
story_program: Adult Mara and Jonah walk from the Fulcrum lab after a coercive late session.

A kiss becomes mutually desired and stops while both still want it.
Stopping increases trust and future possibility rather than punishing desire.
